channel.title: AI News Digest
channel.description: Official AI product updates from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and GitHub

item.title: Holiday Extras is rethinking what it can build with Codex
item.description: With Codex, Holiday Extras is turning customer expertise into better apps, higher booking conversion and new possibilities for growth.

item.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
item.description: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.

item.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
item.description: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety. The work supports shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.

item.title: JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
item.description: JioStar’s Vijay Seshadri explains AI discovery at 500M-user scale. Read his lessons on evals, guardrails, and taking AI into production.

item.title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
item.description: More than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus. See how they use it to prepare for civilian careers.

item.title: End-user safety identifier labels for abuse monitoring
item.description: Feature End-user safety identifier labels for abuse monitoring End-user safety_identifier request labels are available in General Availability (GA) for Gemini ( generateContent and streamGenerateContent ) and Veo ( predictLongRunning ) API calls. API resellers and multi-tenant apps can pass an anonymized per-user ID in labels to attribute policy violations to individual end users. Targeted attribution helps prevent enforcement actions across an entire Google Cloud project.

item.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
item.description: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

item.title: GitHub App support for Enterprise Copilot seat management
item.description: Enterprise GitHub Apps can now call the enterprise-level Copilot seat management APIs to control which users and enterprise teams are assigned Copilot seats. The Copilot seat management APIs are accessible with a new enterprise fine-grained permission for Apps: Enterprise Copilot license management.

item.title: Singapore Airlines elevates travel & work with OpenAI technology
item.description: Discover how Singapore Airlines uses OpenAI models and API to enhance customer support, travel discovery, and employee productivity, doubling CSAT for its Kris chatbot.

item.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
item.description: Manage your business information, get insights about how your business shows up, and turn interest into action in ChatGPT.

item.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
item.description: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.

item.title: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
item.description: New ThinkYoung research and lessons from OpenAI’s EMEA education partnerships on supporting teachers, AI literacy, and independent learning.

item.title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
item.description: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.

item.title: Cross-project governance for semantic governance policies
item.description: Feature Cross-project governance for semantic governance policies You can use semantic governance policies in a multi-project (hub-and-spoke) architecture to centrally govern agents deployed across multiple Google Cloud projects. When you configure a Resource Manager management boundary with the AGENT_MANAGEMENT capability, Agent Registry in the central management project automatically discovers agents across all member projects with their runtime identities intact.

item.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
item.description: AlphaProof Code agents wrote three million lines of proofs in Lean to verify Signal’s core encryption.

item.title: Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
item.description: Gemini Intelligence is rolling out to more devices. See how expanded capabilities across these devices help you do more.

item.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
item.description: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare to unify clinical data and automate workflows. Reduce administrative burnout. See how it works.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available

item.title: We’re bringing Adobe’s creative and productivity tools closer to your everyday Google apps.
item.description: Google and Adobe are integrating creative and productivity tools. Edit PDFs in Drive and use Adobe AI in Gemini. See what’s new in this partnership.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon, Google’s latest model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. It is designed for complex coding, agentic, and reasoning tasks, with a focus on secure code generation and security-focused work.

item.title: C++ language server now auto-configures MSBuild builds
item.description: The Microsoft C++ Language Server for GitHub Copilot CLI now bundles its MSBuild compile commands extractor and invokes it automatically. An agent no longer needs to discover and run a separate configuration skill before it can get precise code intelligence for your project.

item.title: A more informative GitHub dashboard
item.description: Since the new dashboard experience became the default, we’ve heard from developers that it used too much space to show too little. Generous padding, wrapped titles, and a low default item count meant extra navigation just to see what needed attention.

item.title: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering
item.description: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

item.title: Announcements
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
item.description: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

item.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
item.description: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

item.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
item.description: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

item.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 accelerates real-world general dexterity
item.description: Our most capable vision-language-action model enhances robot dexterity, reliability, and safety

item.title: Secret scanning detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs
item.description: GitHub secret scanning now detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs, in addition to issues, wikis, discussions, and pull requests. Actions workflow log scanning is available in public preview.

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Claude Fable 5.2, Anthropic’s newest Fable model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. You can use it for complex, multistep coding tasks across large codebases.

item.title: Preserved thinking
item.description: Thinking blocks that Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 produce work only in the account that produced them, or in an account linked to it. See Preserved thinking.

item.title: prefix_mismatch_behavior
item.description: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 enforce the prefix check for every account, whatever its age. Claude Fable 5.1 returns the error by default on accounts created on or after August 31, 2026 (see When prefix_mismatch_behavior is unset ). If your code edits the system prompt, tools, or an earlier message and then sends back a Claude Fable 5.2 or Claude Mythos 5.2 thinking block from a later turn, the request returns a 400 error. Before you switch, check whether your code edits the prefix.

item.title: Switching models mid-conversation
item.description: No other model reads thinking blocks from Claude Fable 5.2 or Claude Mythos 5.2. When a conversation moves from either one to a model outside this pair, the API drops those blocks. That includes a move to Claude Opus 5.5 or Claude Fable 5.1. The request still succeeds. See Switching models mid-conversation.

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 read other models’ thinking blocks
item.description: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 read other models’ thinking blocks on the Claude API and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed). So on those platforms, a conversation that moves onto either model keeps its reasoning. The other models include Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Claude Haiku 5.5.

item.title: speed: "fast"
item.description: We’ve launched fast mode for Claude Fable 5.2 in Messages API requests on the Claude API. Fast mode delivers up to 2.5x higher output tokens per second, at $16 USD per MTok of input and $80 USD per MTok of output. Set speed: "fast" on your request, with no beta header.

item.title: Dreams
item.description: Dreams (research preview) now supports Claude Fable 5.2. See Supported models.

item.title: computer_toolset_20260801
item.description: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 support computer use through the computer_toolset_20260801 toolset. A request that declares the earlier computer_20251124 tool returns a 400 error on every platform except Amazon Bedrock, where the earlier tool still works. See Migrate from computer_20251124.

item.title: Model-specific data retention requirements
item.description: Both models require 30-day data retention, like Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1. They aren’t available under zero data retention unless expressly authorized by Anthropic. See Model-specific data retention requirements.

item.title: model
item.description: With the advisor tool, which is in beta, a Claude Fable 5.2 or Claude Mythos 5.2 executor accepts only Claude Fable 5.2 or Claude Mythos 5.2 as its advisor. Any other advisor returns a 400 error, so set the advisor’s model to one of these two models when you move an executor to them. Every executor model accepts Claude Fable 5.2 as its advisor. See Model compatibility.

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2
item.description: We’ve launched Claude Fable 5.2 ( claude-fable-5-2 ), built for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. Claude Mythos 5.2 ( claude-mythos-5-2 ) offers the same capabilities only to organizations verified through Anthropic’s verification programs, such as the Cyber Verification Program. Both models have a 1M token context window, 128k max output tokens, and always-on adaptive thinking.

item.title: Copilot code review: API management and review overview updates
item.description: You can now manage GitHub Copilot code review settings through the REST and GraphQL APIs, from enterprise policy down to individual repositories. Copilot’s review overview comment is now more compact, and this update includes fixes for billing, automatic reviews, and reliability.

item.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
item.description: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

item.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
item.description: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

item.title: Dedicated Memory Bank functionality in the Google Cloud console
item.description: Feature Dedicated Memory Bank functionality in the Google Cloud console You can create, configure, and inspect Agent Platform Memory Bank instances from the dedicated Memory Bank page in the Google Cloud console, with updated memory management controls for deployed agents in Agent Runtime: Memory Bank list and creation: View and manage standalone memory banks on the Memory Bank page (separate from deployed agents on the Deployments page), edit basic information or labels, delete instances, and...

item.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 2
item.description: This week, Copilot comes to JetBrains Air and Xcode’s coding assistant, with updates to help you manage pull requests, settings, and agent sessions. GitHub Copilot app Set up Agent Merge directly from a pull request to have Copilot merge it when it’s ready.

item.title: @GitHub in Slack and Teams is generally available and more
item.description: Turn conversations into code with @GitHub in Slack and Teams! Investigate bugs, create issues, implement changes, and open pull requests—all without leaving your conversation.

item.title: Copilot impact dashboard adds chat and VS Code agent usage
item.description: The Agent adoption chart in the Copilot impact dashboard now includes Copilot Chat and the VS Code Agents window, so you can see engagement across nine Copilot experiences. The adoption cohort called “Passive users” is now “Chat-first users”, which better describes who is in it.

item.title: Usage metrics API flags telemetry and version gaps
item.description: The Copilot usage metrics API now shows which users are missing client telemetry or are running IDE or extension versions below the usage metrics minimums. New per-user fields appear in enterprise and organization user reports, and daily affected-user counts appear in enterprise and organization reports.

item.title: Usage metrics API adds code review details and addressed rate
item.description: The enterprise and organization repository-level Copilot usage metrics reports now show what happens to Copilot code review feedback. A new copilot_code_review object on each repos-1-day row reports how many Copilot-reviewed pull requests merged without a later change request from a person and how many Copilot code review comments developers acted on.

item.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
item.description: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.
